title: AE40025: Atmospheric Boundary Layers
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: AE21001
3 - 0 - 0: 3 CreditsAtmospheric motion,
global, regional, and local wind patterns, atmospheric boundary layer
characteristics, effects of surface roughness and topography, vertical wind
profile and stability, surface fluxes, Analysis of atmospheric boundary layer
in terms of time averaged properties, turbulence characteristics, Wind tunnels
for simulation of atmospheric boundary layer, Estimation of wind resources,
Atmospheric pollution.
